monthRecipe.instructions: Duplicate _Month_Template; write one Month_Index row and 31 Daily_Summary rows using the formula patterns below. Substitute __INDEX_ROW__, __SUMMARY_START__ and __SUMMARY_END__ with the selected numeric rows. Beyond capacity, append one registry row and 31 summary rows per additional slot, and change ALL Dashboard Daily_Summary lookup end rows from the verified old bound to 31*newCapacity+1 in the SAME batch. Never scan or rewrite historical meal rows.
